adjudication.rationale: In Topic#expandable_first_post? the host presence check was removed (now only `SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?`). In `spec/models/topic_spec.rb`, the test `it "is false if embeddable_host is blank"` no longer sets `SiteSetting.embed_truncate` nor stubs `has_topic_embed?`, and uses `Fabricate.build(:topic)`, so it will be false for unrelated reasons (default `embed_truncate` false and/or no embed on an unsaved topic). Also, the updated tests only assert the `true` case inside `describe 'with an emeddable host'`, so they don’t pin the new semantics that embeddable hosts are no longer required for `expandable_first_post?` to return true when truncation is enabled and the topic has an embed.
